caption:
The video captures an indoor volleyball rally on a wood-floored court with orange-paneled walls and a net strung between blue padded posts. A player in a black sleeveless jersey stands in the foreground with his back to the camera, while players in white and black stand on the near side and opponents in purple, black and red on the far side. The yellow ball is already aloft high above the court before descending toward the net, where a far-side player with raised arms redirects it upward. The left bench stays in view.

The ball climbs to a second apex, drifting slightly right, before descending toward the net again. Two far-side players leap with arms extended to meet it, after which the ball travels leftward and downward across the net. On the near side, the white-jerseyed number four walks left and pauses, a player in black with white shorts moves into the left area, and the foreground player shifts his weight. The rally is still in progress as the clip ends, the ball falling toward the near court.
relations: Ball descends toward net where a far-side player with raised arms redirects it upward.
Ball climbs to a second apex drifting right, then falls toward the net again.
Two far-side players leap to meet the ball, sending it leftward across the net.
Near-side players shift positions and weight tracking the ball's descent toward their court.
